title: Practice 6: Object clauses: что, чтобы, ли

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (работать + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) гирудотерапия?
exercises.prompt: Does leech therapy work?
exercises.why: **работать → Работает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (можно + ли) вычислить диаметр, зная длину окружности?
exercises.prompt: Is it possible to determine the diameter from the circumference?
exercises.why: **Можно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (можно): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (быть + ли, impf., fut. 3rd sg.) фрексит вслед за брекситом?
exercises.prompt: Will Frexit follow Brexit?
exercises.why: **быть → Будет ли** — future of быть: 3rd person singular. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (пить + ли, impf., pres. 3rd pl.) бостонцы воду из-под крана?
exercises.prompt: Do people in Boston drink tap water?
exercises.why: **пить → Пьют ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (бывать + ли, impf., pres. 3rd pl.) насекомые без усиков?
exercises.prompt: Are there insects without antennae?
exercises.why: **бывать → Бывают ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (говорить + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) он на тагальском?
exercises.prompt: Does he speak Tagalog?
exercises.why: **говорить → Говорит ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (мочь + ли, impf., pres. 1st pl.) мы его вызволить из тюрьмы?
exercises.prompt: Can we get him out of jail?
exercises.why: **мочь → Можем ли** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (виноватый + ли) Республиканская партия в нынешнем экономическом кризисе?
exercises.prompt: Is the GOP to blame for the current economic crisis?
exercises.why: **виноватый → Виновата ли** — short form (fem.): -а. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Не ___ (маловатый + ли) ей лет?
exercises.prompt: Isn't she a bit young?
exercises.why: **маловатый → маловато ли** — short form (neut.): -о. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Думаю, не ___ (неграмотный + ли) Том.
exercises.prompt: I wonder if Tom is illiterate.
exercises.why: **неграмотный → неграмотен ли** — short form (masc.): no ending. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (этично + ли) клонировать людей?
exercises.prompt: Is it ethical to clone humans?
exercises.why: **Этично ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (этично): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (действительно + ли) Бог повелевает мусульманам убивать немусульман?
exercises.prompt: Does God really command Muslims to kill non-Muslims?
exercises.why: **Действительно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (действительно): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (успеть + ли, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) он на поезд?
exercises.prompt: Will he be able to catch the train?
exercises.why: **успеть → Успеет ли** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (являться + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) агрессия естественной или же благоприобретенной?
exercises.prompt: Is aggression natural, or is it learned?
exercises.why: **являться → Является ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (являться + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) Том очевидцем?
exercises.prompt: Is Tom an eyewitness?
exercises.why: **являться → Является ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (знать + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) он о сложности?
exercises.prompt: Is he aware of the difficulty?
exercises.why: **знать → Знает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (повлиять + ли, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) это на туризм?
exercises.prompt: Will this affect tourism?
exercises.why: **повлиять → Повлияет ли** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (осмелиться + ли, pf., fut. 1st sg.) спросить: куда и в какие места ехать изволите?
exercises.prompt: Dare I ask where and to which places you would like to go?
exercises.why: **осмелиться → Осмелюсь ли** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Ящеролюды ___ (вряд + ли) существуют.
exercises.prompt: Lizard people probably aren't real.
exercises.why: **вряд ли** — a set phrase: «hardly, unlikely».

exercises.q: ___ (мочь + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) быть, чтобы девушка двадцати двух лет никогда не видела эротических снов?
exercises.prompt: Is it possible that a 22 year old girl never had erotic dreams?
exercises.why: **мочь → Может ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.
